A '''HoloNet router''' was a communication device used in [[uplink station]]s. As part of [[Operation Thunderbolt]], the [[Sullustan Resistance]] planned to destroy the HoloNet router in [[G'rinn Go city]]'s [[SoroSuub secure uplink station|uplink station]], thereby cutting the [[City/Legends|city]] off from the rest of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
